sentences.en: The building's superintendent has set up a meeting with the residents.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑的管理员已经安排了与居民们的会议。

sentences.en: The public housing superintendent used to receive bribes from the aging tenant.
sentences.zh: 公共住房的管理人过去常常接受老年租户的贿赂。

sentences.en: Ah, Superintendent Chalmers! Welcome. I hope you're prepared for an unforgettable luncheon!
sentences.zh: 啊，查尔默斯主管！欢迎。希望您准备好了一顿难忘的午餐！

phrases.zh: 学校主管：负责学校的管理人员
